data.title: Grief on Chinese internet as wait for Tibet flood news drags on
data.description: BEIJING - Photos of sons, daughters, uncles and husbands have peppered Chinese social media, shared by people hoping for news about relatives missing since deadly floods on the border with Nepal last week.

data.title: Putin denies plan for new Russia military call up
data.description: MOSCOW — Russia has no present need to mobilise more men for its Ukraine offensive, President Vladimir Putin said Thursday, describing speculation about another military call-up as Ukrainian "disinformation".

data.title: Caruana Galizia: 'one-woman WikiLeaks' who exposed Malta's shady side
data.description: VALLETTA - Illicit trafficking, bribes, offshore accounts: Maltese journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia, murdered with a car bomb in 2017, fearlessly exposed corruption in her archipelago in the heart of the Mediterranean.

data.title: Thai lawmaker gets messages of support from Myanmar citizens after protest
data.description: A Thai opposition lawmaker who drew wide attention for disrupting his country's official welcome of Myanmar military chief-turned-President Min Aung Hlaing last month said he received many messages from Myanmar citizens supporting his action, which he said was meant as a protest against military rule.

data.title: Seating collapse halts Thai rockers’ farewell show
data.description: Music fans attending a farewell concert by the legendary Thai rock band Asanee & Wasan were sent home before they could even say their goodbyes after part of a temporary elevated VIP seating structure collapsed.

data.title: Kuwait's Iranians under pressure since start of war
data.description: KUWAIT CITY — A Persian restaurant in Kuwait has removed any mention of Iran from its name, a sign of the pressure the Iranian community in the Gulf country has faced since the Middle East war erupted.

data.title: Outrage mounts in Malta after acquittal over journalist's murder
data.description: VALLETTA — Hundreds of people demonstrated in the Maltese capital Valletta after a wealthy businessman was found not guilty of masterminding the murder of an investigative journalist.

data.title: EU lawmakers demand Brussels force Meta to 'protect' children
data.description: BRUSSELS — European lawmakers demanded that the European Union (EU) executive force Meta to change the "addictive" design of its platforms in Europe, as the giant has promised to do in some US states, according to a letter seen by Agence France-Presse ( AFP ) on Thursday.

data.title: Delivering aid to Nepal flood survivors 'very, very difficult': UN
data.description: KATHMANDU (NEPAL) - Reaching survivors of Nepal's devastating floods has bee an immense challenge with the delivery of basic aid supplies hampered, the United Nations explained Thursday, considering the use of cargo drones and porters in addition to destroyed roads.

data.title: Three hurt in explosion at Samut Prakan factory
data.description: Three workers were injured when a machine exploded inside a car-seat factory in Bang Bo district of Samut Prakan province on Thursday afternoon.

data.title: Sansiri launches fund to acquire Italian luxury hotel asset
data.description: Sansiri Capital plans to acquire 100% of The Lake Como EDITION in Italy, a luxury hotel asset valued at more than EUR200 million.

data.title: From distributor to shareholder: Banobagi's Thai success story
data.description: MsMean — Yosaporn Suwanwichian, CEO of Beyond Beauty Trade Co Ltd, a leading importer and distributor of beauty products — has gone beyond simply being an importer. She successfully introducedBanobagifacial masks to the Thai market, securing the position of Watsons' best-selling facial mask for seven consecutive years.

data.title: Feminist trailblazer Gloria Steinem dies at age 92
data.description: ⁠The trailblazing American feminist ⁠activist ​and ​journalist Gloria ‌Steinem has died at the age ​92, her ​foundation said ⁠on Thursday.

data.title: Hender Scheme and Artek releases shoes for stools
data.description: From being fashion’s favoured stool to now getting its own pair of shoes, Artek’s iconic Finnish-designed Stool 60 is getting a new look through a collaboration collection with Japanese leather artisan brand Hender Scheme.

data.title: El Niño could be strongest in decades, UN warns
data.description: GENEVA — El Niño could be the strongest since records began four decades ago, the United Nations' climate agency warned Thursday, with the United Nations (UN) chief warning the world is in the "danger zone of extreme weather".

data.title: Mahidol advances Thailand High Performance Centre
data.description: Mahidol University is seeking global expertise to help develop the Thailand High Performance Centre, following meetings with leading sports organisations in Zurich.

data.title: US sailors on leave begin exploring Pattaya
data.description: PATTAYA - Hordes of US sailors were up early on Thursday as they set out to explore this tourist city on their second day of shore leave.

data.title: Bangkok brings more homeless into system but many decline help
data.description: A new campaign to tackle homelessness in Bangkok has brought some people into the system but a majority are declining help, according to Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA).

data.title: Porsche Thailand presents Haus of Porsche:
data.description: Porsche Thailand invites Cayenne owners and Porsche fans to experience Haus of Porsche: Cayenne Edition from Sept 5 to 9 at Das Haus BKK, bringing the community together to discover more about the sporty SUV through its heritage and evolution, driving performance, versatility and lifestyle. A key highlight on Sept 5 will be the first and largest gathering of Cayenne drivers in Southeast Asia, alongside the first unveiling of the Cayenne Coupé Electric in Thailand. From Sept 6 to 9, the experience opens up to the public, with curated test-drive experiences and a range of activities that showcase the Porsche ownership experience extending beyond the drive, while creating a space for the Cayenne community to connect, share their passion and create memories together.

data.title: Russia to close branches of Germany's Goethe Institute
data.description: MOSCOW — Russia will close multiple branches of Germany's Goethe Institute in response to Germany ordering the closure of a Russian cultural centre in Berlin, Moscow said Thursday, amid spiralling tensions between the two countries.

data.title: Indonesia protesters targeted by coordinated disinfo
data.description: JAKARTA — Disinformation about recent anti-government protests in Indonesia has inundated social media in what researchers say is a coordinated attempt to spread propaganda about the one-year-old movement.

data.title: Thailand urged to strengthen stroke care as ageing society raises risks
data.description: A new Siemens Healthineers report highlights Thailand’s stroke burden, regional care gaps and the need for stronger emergency response systems.

data.title: Missing woman’s family fears harm from boyfriend
data.description: CHANTHABURI - The family of a woman missing for nearly a week has appealed to the public for help, after her boyfriend denied seeing her despite CCTV footage showing him picking her on the day she was last seen.

data.title: Spacecraft bound for Mercury faces 'tricky' arrival
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - A spacecraft carrying European and Japanese probes will complete an eight-year journey to arrive at Mercury on Thursday, while still facing high-risk manoeuvres to study the Sun-scorched planet.

data.title: Gallothai: Three Decades of Chocolate Craftsmanship
data.description: Since 1993 , Gallothai has been one of Thailand's leading chocolate manufacturers, blending Belgian craftsmanship with the character of Thai ingredients and terroir.The company holds certifications including ISO 22000 and SMETA at its Chachoengsao facility, with offices in Bangkok, Chiang Mai, and Phuket, and has spent the last 33 years handcrafting chocolates and pastries that blend Belgian expertise with locally sourced Thai ingredients.

data.title: ONE Championship: Selina Flores relishes underdog role against Stamp Fairtex and promises ‘domination’
data.description: Selina Flores is embracing the underdog role ahead of her ONE Fight Night 47 main event against Stamp Fairtex – and says she plans to turn the biggest opportunity of her career into a dominant victory in Bangkok.

data.title: Red-whiskered bulbul added to no-hunting list
data.description: National parks officials have stepped up efforts to protect the red-whiskered bulbul by adding the species to the list of wildlife that may not be hunted in 40 additional no-hunting areas in Thailand.

data.title: In Ghana, larger-than-life coffins tell the stories of the dead
data.description: ACCRA - Frederick Teiko Ofori spent a large portion of his life with a guitar in his hands, so when the Ghanaian musician died in a road accident, his family decided that the instrument should accompany him on his final journey.

data.title: "Cockroach-free" Hokkaido faces rise in insects due to climate change
data.description: KYODO — Japan's northernmost main island of Hokkaido, long known for its reputation as being largely cockroach free, may begin to see more of the insects as factors including warmer temperatures spurred by climate change create ideal environments for cockroaches to thrive.

data.title: Kamphaeng Phet school shooter faces several charges
data.description: The teenage student who fired multiple shots at his school in Kamphaeng Phet province faces several charges while the school is closed for two days for safety revisions.

data.title: New movies out this week: Sept 3-9
data.description: Eight new titles to hit cinemas in Thailand this week.

data.title: Shangri-La Bangkok Unveils 2026 Mooncake Collection with KTC Privileges
data.description: (Bangkok, 31 August 2026) – Ms. Elaine Yue, Area General Manager – Cambodia, Myanmar and General Manager – Shangri-La Bangkok, and Ms. Varitta Phatanarajta, Head of Credit Card Marketing Division – KTC, recently joined forces to host the launch of “The Legendary Shangri-La Bangkok Mooncake Collection 2026,” offering exclusive privileges for KTC credit cardholders. A highlight of the event was a special Mooncake Cooking Demonstration by Chef Sakkarin Kansorn, Master Mooncake Chef.

data.title: Families descend on Nepal in search of missing tourists
data.description: KATHMANDU (NEPAL) - Desperate families of missing foreigners were clinging to hope as they combed hospitals and morgues in search of clues, a week after catastrophic floods tore through Nepal's Himalayan border region.

data.title: Satisfy opens Paris flagship(s)
data.description: After gaining serious momentum globally in recent years, the high-end running and lifestyle brand Satisfy is returning to its Parisian roots with its first permanent flagship store — or rather, two.
